description: This file defines the ReviewerGroup entity class using Doctrine ORM annotations, representing reviewer group data in the OrangeHRM performance plugin.

classes.name: ReviewerGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer group with properties such as id, name, piority, and associated reviewers, along with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the reviewer group.

methods.name: getPiority
methods.description: Returns the 'piority' (priority) of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setPiority
methods.description: Sets the 'piority' (priority) of the reviewer group.
